scenario: [RCTS.1.2.1]: no object in a fixture, at any depth, repeats a member name, and a harness must refuse one that does. Here `expect` names `reason` twice, both times `RCTS.1.2.1`, so the member that decides the verdict is the one repeated, and either reading of it agrees. A harness that does not look for repeats finds a well-formed fixture, has no refusal to match `expect.reason` against, and fails it as accepted. This is the behavioural categories' copy of compiler/RCTS.1.2.1_repeated_member_refused: the Mercury runtime's suite reads these categories through its own `run_fixture`, not the compiler suite's. [RCTS.1.2.15]: it passes only when the harness refuses it under [RCTS.1.2.1], and no runtime is driven. PATH PINNED: `load_fixture_json` and `_format_refusal` in specs/conformance/harness/runner.py; `rcts_1_2_1_parse_corpus_json` (compiler/mercury/src/dsc.json.m) and `rcts_fixture_format` (compiler/mercury/test/test_conformance.m), reached from compiler/mercury/test/test_behave.m's `run_fixture`.
